title: Q4 launch sync
transcript: Sara: Let's lock the launch date. Are we still good for December 1st? Omar: Yes, but the pricing page isn't done. I can finish it by Friday. Sara: Great. Liam, can you send the beta users the migration guide this week? Liam: Sure, I'll send it by Wednesday. Sara: We also agreed to drop the annual discount for now. One risk: the payment provider hasn't approved our account yet. Someone should chase them. Omar: I'll ping them today, it's urgent.
